interface.signature: check(N: int, M: int, Edges: List[List[int]]) -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of vertices N must be between 1 and 10.
The number of edges M must be between 1 and 15.
Each edge must be represented by a list of two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= edge[0] <= N and 1 <= edge[1] <= N for edge in Edges)
preconditions.description: Each vertex in an edge must be between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (True if there exists a Hamiltonian path in the graph else False)
postconditions.description: The function returns True if there is a Hamiltonian path in the graph, otherwise False.
